thread:
nina: Heads up — kairos-v2 q5_dynamic bring-up showing weird detok/layout errors for Thai + Arabic inline spans. Parentheses jump and Arabic digits get reordered. Minimal repro below.
omar: Drop the exact command + the input snippet?
nina: Ran quick local smoke with cpu_fallback (pack) on my laptop:
```
./tools/local_eval --model=repo/kairos-v2:q5 --suite=locale_smoke_min --input=tests/th_ar_mixed.json --batch=1
```
Input (literal):
```
วันนี้ไปสวนสาธารณะ（مرحبا １２３）แล้วก็กลับบ้าน
```
Observed output:
```
（مرحبا ۳۲۱）วันนี้ไปสวนสาธารณะแล้วก็กลับบ้าน
```
Note: Arabic digits reversed (123 -> 321) and closing fullwidth paren moved to before the Thai clause.
jiho: Metrics: fp16 baseline BLEU=30.2 -> kairos-q5=21.0 on the mini-suite. chrF down -5.9. Token mismatch +46/190; concentrated on cases where RTL/Arabic occurs inside fullwidth CJK style punctuation or parentheses.
eval-bot: auto-report created: id=ml-smoke-3601234567-a; model_sha=4c8b2f; repo=infra/models/kairos-v2; kernel=cpu_pack_v2
nina: run config (excerpt):
```
quant:
  scheme: q5_dynamic
runtime:
  fallback: cpu_pack_v2
tokenizer:
  detok: pack-detok-v1
```
omar: pack-detok-v1 is the older bundled detok. We recently moved fp16 packs to pack-detok-v2 which preserves BIDI marks for short spans. Could be the packer is normalizing ZWJ/ZWNJ during q5 packing.
jiho: I grep'd the packer logs: `pack_tokens()` replaces U+200D with U+200B when run with `--compress-small` (default for q5). That would break shaping and mirror flags in short spans.
omar: Plan: (1) repack the q5 artifact forcing `--preserve-zwj`; (2) re-run the mini-suite; (3) if repro disappears, update packer defaults for quant compress levels.
nina: mitigation: pinned kairos-v2-fp16 for any routes with locale=th+rtl and added sample thar-3601234567 to `tests/multilang_seeds.json`.
canary-bot: Canary hold applied: kairos-v2 q5 auto-promote disabled in ap-southeast-1 until triage completes. Reason: locale detok regression.
jiho: also adding a focused unit test to locale_smoke_min asserting numeric orientation and bracket attachment for short mixed spans. Will make it a pre-promote gate for quant builds.
omar: I'll try a quick repack and push a candidate artifact later today. Nina — can you attach the failing logs to the ticket?
nina: uploaded logs to s3://redwood-triage/3601234567/kairos-q5-logs.tar.gz and opened RI-1824. Tagging @jiho for the test PR.
canary-bot: Rollback rule: BLEU delta >4 on canary suite or user error-rate >2/min -> route to kairos-v2-fp16.
nina: thanks team — marking monitored for now. reactions: :mag_right: :white_check_mark:
omar: ping me if you want help running repack locally or validating codepoint diffs.
jiho: will post test PR link here once ready.
